ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 75:25 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous high-intensity white fields centrally on both lobes; low-intensity dark pigmentation concentrated along the leading edges and radiating from the median notch; stochastic dark mottling dispersed throughout the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees and a bounding-box depth of roughly 15% of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous boundary exhibiting low-amplitude irregularities; higher frequency and amplitude pixel variations (serrations) observed at the distal tips; moderate smoothness towards the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature fitted to the outer boundaries from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of multiple dark circular pixel clusters (approx. 5-15 pixels in diameter) scattered across the medial and distal white regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: High-density network of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) cutting across the primary white pigmentation, most prominent on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake mark scarring across both lobes; circular rosette scars; irregular, jagged margins at the distal lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark horizontal pigment streak located in the lower-left quadrant of the right lobe white field.
